text:
ordered a mcchicken set with star fires and an affogato (coffee and ice cream).

but the affogato came with barely any coffee or ice cream. ice cream was all melted and when i asked the staff, they said “because the coffee is hot”. to begin with, there was BARELY any ice cream i.e. when i used the spoon to lift the “ice cream”, it was a tiny slab left

i dont blame the service staff, the auntie that pass me the food was really nice, but im questioning why im getting melted ice cream mixed with coffee.

instantly stunned when i saw it because the last few times i got this, it was fine. when looking at pics online, what im getting is really different.

mcchicken and star fries were fine of course, but paying EXTRA compared to normal outlets (since its in orchard) then getting this, lowkey disappointing

attached some pics for reference.
author: wackasmore

text:
I ordered hot fudge sundae, an americano and 1 fries without salt. I ordered table service as its inconvenient to get the food while pushing the baby pram.

Order came with hot fudge dried up and salted, cold, soggy fries with salt. Staff ignored about the wrong order of fries so i went to counter to request for the correct order. Staff still argued that its correct before the manager step in. However, they forgotten about it, i got to go back to counter to remind them. After getting my order, i push my pram and took the food all by myself back to my seat.

My first bad service encounter after having Macdonalds for so many years. Other branches have better service.

Apart from the bad service, I still love the view from my seat with my baby pram. Its a good place for writing during weekdays.
author: Eliza K

text: I ordered a McSpicy with Cheese Upsized Meal from Shaw House during my lunch break. There are mentioned that the Large French Fries would come with curry sauce, in the grab but I did not receive any. If not curry sauce, at least provide more chilli packets, but only 2 were given. I also ordered a McCafé Premium Roast Coffee with milk. There was no sugar or creamer provided. When I drank the coffee, it was completely unsweetened. Basic items like sugar should not be missed. I paid a total of $17.61 and received zero satisfaction. This was a very disappointing online ordering experience. Please improve your service and check orders properly before sending them out.
